objective: Policy changed since last audit (tested v1.0 -> now v2.0). Re-baseline testing against POL-ORD-001_v2.0 and re-assess prior high-risk KRIs.

open_high_risk_kris.description: Orders recognized without valid PO or contract
Orders from low credit-rated customers booked without required

carried_forward_recommendations: Introduce a secondary commitment document requirement beyond PO alone
Enhance credit risk assessment beyond single-factor credit rating to include payment history and country risk
Formalize system-based sign-off workflow to eliminate verbal approval gaps
